correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, the upper bound counts primitive weight-three cyclic classes after excluding the unique periodic class when 3 divides n. The construction with ones at (0,i,j), 1<=i<=floor(n/3), i<j<=n-floor(n/3)-1, is non-overlapping: possible suffix matches starting at i or j have respectively two or one marker versus three or at least two in every equally long code prefix. Exact summation reaches the orbit upper bound in all three residues. Literal exhaustive pair/orbit computations for n=3..26 and count identities through n=1000 corroborate but do not constitute the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact optimal cardinality for every blocklength under a natural three-marker synchronization/composition restriction, with a direct structured encoder and complete primitive necklace transversal. The construction is not a routine bound application because an unconstrained necklace transversal need not satisfy the global overlap prohibition, and achieving the orbit cap is precisely the nontrivial part.
